column3: “a person” renders “a soul (nefesh),” and “unintentionally” renders “by inadvertence (shegagah).”
“sprinkle” renders “spatter,” and “the veil” renders “parokhet,” the curtain (also in verse 17).
NASB puts the comparison with the peace offering in parentheses.
NASB supplies “that is, all the rest of”; “a clean place” renders “a pure place,” and “the ashes” renders “the fatty ashes.”
“the LORD God” renders “the LORD his God.”
NASB supplies “the rest of” before “its blood” (also in verse 30).
“anyone of the common people” renders “one soul of the people of the land.”
